class.name: jetank_motor_control/JetankSerialHardware
class.description: Hardware interface for JeTank ST/SC (Feetech SMS/STS) serial bus servos. Communicates via UART (default /dev/ttyTHS1 @ 1Mbps) with daisy-chained servos. Joints with a servo_id param drive a real servo; joints without one (gripper_right mimic, wheels) mirror command to state.
